title: Endpoint-selected current-city research walk
description: Shortest mapped walk with conditional physiology, optional Health field replay and explicit modelled crossing waits/current recorded traffic gaps; no health optimization or validated safe clearance.

assumed_background_pm25_ug_m3.description: Assumed PM2.5 background from the original local scenario; not observed current city background.

pmx_to_pm25_proxy_fraction.description: Experimental fraction of city exhaust PMx assigned to a PM2.5 proxy; not a calibrated size conversion.

max_temperature_fill_m.description: Maximum route-position to valid cell-centre distance for an explicitly estimated air temperature.

max_pmx_fill_m.description: Maximum route-position to valid cell-centre distance for an explicitly estimated PMx increment.

solar_warming_c_per_800.description: Original heuristic solar warming at 800 W/m2; does not replace air temperature in CVAE.

breathing_history_offset_s.description: Offset into the retained historical private physiology template, independent of city observation time.

followup_until_elapsed_s.description: Optional assumed stationary follow-up after arrival; must fit the declared Health model and solar coverage.

origin.description: Exact selected start node in the pinned walking network.

goal.description: Exact selected destination node in the pinned walking network.

speed_m_s.description: Illustrative walking speed while moving; explicit crossing waits add stationary time.

departure_s.description: Relative Health departure within model coverage; field replay is only permitted by the explicit time policy.

field_time_policy.description: Native source coverage, or explicit Health-only smooth periodic pollution/temperature replay. Solar and model state do not reset.

field_replay_blend_s.description: Smoothstep blend to the first frame at the end of each Health replay cycle; reproduces the original local 60-second transition.

spatial_missing_method.description: Missing pollution/sunlight only: nearest donor or inverse-distance-squared weighting of up to four valid cells within the field-specific bound. Temperature retains its declared nearest-cell policy; native samples are unchanged.

max_sunlight_fill_m.description: Health-only spatial sunlight estimate radius. Zero preserves native-only behavior. Solar uses its original day clock; no nighttime or missing samples are replaced by arbitrary zero.

crossing_policy.description: Explicit Health-only modelled pedestrian gates at pinned source crosswalks, plus newer recorded vehicle gaps where available. The short traffic clip is repeated; not surveyed pedestrian signals or safe navigation.

crossing_green_s.description: Minimum assumed pedestrian green duration; enlarged for the full tagged crossing length and selected speed.

crossing_clearance_s.description: Assumed pedestrian clearance after green, plus a fixed two-second admission margin.
